preconditions.description: The input integer k must be between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: any(G[i][j] == 'Y' for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i != j)
preconditions.description: There must be at least one edge in the graph.

postconditions.description: The output must be a valid adjacency matrix with n vertices.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for path in paths if path[0] == 1 and path[-1] == 2) == k
postconditions.description: The number of shortest paths between vertex 1 and vertex 2 must be exactly k.
